title: Mo' Mobes
description: Mo' Mobes is a Datapack that adds new unique creatures to Minecraft quickly and easily.
body:
# **_Mo' Mobes_  Is Here!**
Are you bored with the old mob? This is the solution if you feel that way...
------------------------------------------------------------------------
*Mo’ Mobes*
Bring more life to your Minecraft world with new mobs!

*Mo’ Mobes* is a datapack that expands Minecraft’s mob variety. It doesn’t just keep the vanilla mobs as they are it adds new variants, unique equipment that make every encounter fresh and unpredictable.

-|What’s New?
Unique but Vanilla-Friendly New Mobs
These are special variants of existing Minecraft mobs,.. no new models, no mods required, just creative combinations of vanilla mechanics.

|Naturally Integrated into the Game
All new mobs spawn as part of the normal Minecraft world generation, blending seamlessly with existing gameplay.

|Balanced for Survival
Challenging enough to be exciting, but fair for players who are prepared.

-|Technical Info

|Minecraft Version: 1.21.8+

|Works On: Singleplayer & Multiplayer
